supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Extension visible beyond the outer corners of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between light muzzle and dark cheek/periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with structural droop

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: Right ear is significantly reduced in size and lacks upward vertical extension compared to the left

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Apparent truncation or folding of the right ear pinna
